content.text: This citation integrity audit of the manuscript identified three major issues: one phantom reference ([3]), one retracted study cited without qualification ([2]), and one unsupported claim where the cited source does not address clinical trial outcomes ([4]). Overall, the manuscript requires careful revision of its bibliography and alignment between claims and supporting literature.
